checks: Create stores job description, location, salary, notes, due date and linked local documents; links open the right editor.
List stage menus and board drag/drop persist transitions; first Applied transition records its date.
Calendar and follow-up agenda complete reminders and reschedule them by seven days.
Description search, stage counts and filters work; JSON preserves metadata and CSV prevents spreadsheet formulas.
Backup recovery round trips all metadata, keeps existing IDs, and rejects impossible dates without changing storage.
Corrupt storage stays untouched until explicit backup recovery; quota failure retains the draft and Escape restores focus.
A concurrent tracker change is detected before save and preserved instead of being overwritten.
Desktop and 390 px board/list/calendar fit the viewport, delete preserves other jobs, and no browser errors occur.
